ad61d15cb2f4: What is a B2B booking system for travel agencies?
6b31aebfee9f: A B2B booking system is an online platform reserved for travel professionals: a tour operator, consolidator or agency makes its products available to its partner agencies, which search, compare and book them on their own, in real time.
35d1bbc291ee: With Travelife, your customers are travel agents, tour operators, local booking agents and other agencies. The portal lets you manage your relationships with customers, distributors and partners through a single platform, while all bookings arrive directly in your back office.
2f185be6fce7: How do partner agencies access the Travelife B2B portal?
1e1771faae63: Each partner agency receives a personal username and password to log in to your B2B portal, on web and mobile. Access is secure and the content displayed depends on the terms you have set for that partner.
501f9aff94b6: Once logged in, the partner searches your flights, hotels, package tours and services with detailed filters (country, hotel, price…), books in a few clicks, then manages their own account: purchase and payment history, downloadable documents, changes and cancellations.
3654e8814175: Can I set a credit limit and different rates for each partner?
f7d84fba2d2b: Yes. The Travelife B2B booking system manages your partners’ credit limits and the cancellation policies that apply to their bookings: available credit is checked automatically with every booking.
ed0f3c526344: You can also dynamically adjust your commercial policies, pricing and markups. Prices are calculated instantly and always up to date for the partner, and the portal lets you digitally track each agency’s accounts, members, loyalty programs and commissions.
e88da0d9ed8b: What products can I sell through the B2B booking system?
0c1ea629de98: You can distribute flights, hotels, package tours, transfers, car rentals and other travel services to your partners. These products come from both your internal catalog and the suppliers connected to Travelife.
dffd2655c249: Thanks to multiple supplier APIs integrated into a single feed, the portal gives access to more than 1,500 airlines and 500,000 accommodations, via GDSs (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) and hotel bed banks such as Hotelbeds and WebBeds.
247ccd05f437: Do I need technical skills to launch my B2B portal?
85969b7802ae: No. The Travelife B2B booking system requires no coding or design skills: the platform is ready to use and the Travelife team handles setup and configuration.
3289595d46ec: Everything remains customizable to your brand and markets: language, currencies, design. Bookings made by your partners are automatically linked to the Travelife Manage back office, where you generate orders, invoices and payments in a single click.
1108dd4a0ca2: Can the B2B booking platform be funded by GO SIYAHA?
eb9985c1bace: Yes. Travelife is listed with Maroc PME under the GO SIYAHA program, dedicated to the digital transformation of travel agencies in Morocco, and the B2B booking platform is one of the eligible services, with funding of up to 90%.
20834642e9d0: The travel agency management software, B2C website, digital marketing support and SmartCRM are also eligible. Check your agency’s eligibility.
